profile.headline: Founder of OG Assist | Human-centered Leader | Ride the Worm
profile.summary:
I build AI products that work in production for thousands of organizations with real stakes — and I’ve been thinking carefully about what AI’s structural transformation of software engineering actually means, beyond the productivity narrative.
At OpenGov I founded OG Assist and ran it end to end: product definition, platform architecture, and the team — hired, managed, directed day to day. The product is an agentic platform across a heterogeneous ERP serving 2,000+ government organizations; the product and the architecture were the same set of decisions. In parallel, M&A technical due diligence on both sides of the table — evaluating acquisition targets, and representing the company through its own acquisition.
That decade is the most recent of two. I’ve been writing software since 2001 — 2006 in earnest — long enough for the terrain to change under me more than once, and long enough to know that what survives each change is judgment, not technique.
My essays — “Ride the Worm” and “Seeing the Field” — carry the rest: empirical precision, precision boundaries discovered rather than specified, the speciation of the discipline into formal and organic branches.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founder of OG Assist. Leading AI agents product development with dual product and technical execution responsibilities, managing a cross-functional team.

Key contributions:
- Designed and shipped production RAG systems, LLM-based question answering, and agentic workflows serving 2,000+ government organizations — high-stakes environments requiring strict accuracy, auditability, and compliance governance.
- Architected tool-augmented, skill-based AI agent systems using LangGraph and frontier LLMs, establishing reliable agent behavior patterns for sensitive government data contexts.
- Serve on the architecture review board providing cross-organizational technical governance, driving API standardization, tech stack convergence, and platform architecture decisions.
- Bootstrapped multiple product teams from zero — reporting, access control, component libraries, and new product lines — through hiring, technical design, and delivery.
- Pioneered AI integration across R&D and in-product, establishing the company's AI strategy and technical foundations.

positions.title: Principal Architect
positions.description: Led API and tech stack standardization across multiple product teams, driving convergence from heterogeneous systems to unified platform architecture. Provided technical leadership and mentorship for engineering teams, establishing modularization patterns and review processes.

positions.title: Senior Architect
positions.description: Skills: Technical Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Created interactive, WebGL accelerated map visualizations handling tens of thousands of GeoJSON features in a React/Redux/Immutable.js application. Created and released two NPM packages with an MIT license: react-leaflet-cluster-layer and react-leaflet-heatmap-layer. Contributed to Ruby/Rails backend handling CRUD operations and PostGIS queries. Took on the role of ScrumMaster for a distributed team. Mentored and supported junior engineers. Provided architectural guidance for the implementation of a new event driven service architecture. Modernized JavaScript tooling and optimized Webpack builds in multiple applications.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Building an iOS journaling application that mixes journal entries with calendar events, reminders, mail messages, and web history. Utilizes React Native and JavaScript for the user interface. It also uses Core Data, Swift, EventKit, and others to provide an integrated user experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Implemented new features in React/Flux/Immutable.js application. Modernized JavaScript tooling and language support with Webpack build optimizations, hot loading, ES6 migration, and a Node.js major version upgrade. Improved the performance of the VR video player in “Provata VR” for iOS, now available in the App Store. Upgraded Java services to Jersey 2 and Java 8. Implemented and seamlessly transitioned to OAuth 2.0 with JWT Bearer Tokens for authentication and authorization. Implemented authorization framework for Jersey services and many other features.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead the design and implementation of a distributed, scalable application architecture for DataDash, a powerful reporting platform. Review the engineering team's code. Standardize modularization patterns and coding best practices. Manage Amazon AWS infrastructure. Full-stack web development with Node.js, Backbone, Angular, and React.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Developed APIs and web applications with Node.js, MongoDB, and Backbone. Worked throughout the project lifecycle to inform architectural and design decisions with technical perspective.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Implemented new features in Tomcat J2EE web application including MySQL database schema changes, new Java beans, and modifications to a JSP and Dojo frontend. Managed project Maven dependencies, Gitlab merge requests, Hudson configurations and builds, and manual deployments to Windows-hosted Tomcat servers. Developed JBoss RESTful API to integrate user management with Salesforce. Reviewed outages and performance metrics in New Relic APM.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Developed the High Availability plugin to provide vendor-agnostic database replication, failover, and automated migration between databases. Developed new features in ServiceNow's core Java platform. Fixed bugs across the entire stack from debugging Bash scripts to resolving database layer issues in Java to client-side JavaScript and CSS styling. Debugged memory leaks, database race conditions, and other resource contention issues with YourKit profiler.

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description: Developed automation for use by the technical support and operations teams using JavaScript, ServiceNow’s Runbook Automation, and Bash scripts. Fixed bugs in ServiceNow Java platform. Worked with customers to develop, test, deploy, and configure ServiceNow Discovery functionality for populating and monitoring a CMDB. Provided 24-hour on call support in a rotation with the technical support team.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Maintained, debugged, and performed periodic feature updates to ASP web application at RealCapitalMarkets.com. Integrated external client web sites with ASP web application so that users viewed a branded portal. Debugged stored procedures for performance tuning on SQL Server 2005. Enhanced web application to receive and handle customer assistance requests.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed Java application for conversion of raw data files to formatted spreadsheets for use by sales call center. Developed and maintained vendor portal around ASP.NET on MSSQL Server 2000. Designed and maintained many web sites consisting of hundreds of pages. Lead migration of hosted properties to LAMP platform. Responsible for system installation, upgrade, and maintenance of Windows servers.
